d: COGNNA is a fast-growing cybersecurity startup revolutionizing how businesses manage their security operations. Our innovative SaaS platform empowers SMEs and enterprises to detect, prevent, and respond to cyber threats with agility and confidence. Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, we’re building a resilient, AI-powered future for cybersecurity — locally and globally.

We are seeking a hands-on Sales Manager who will lead, coach, and develop a sales team while maintaining direct responsibility for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts and an individual revenue target. The successful candidate will be accountable for both personal sales achievement and the team's overall performance.
q: li
7–10+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including at least 4–5 years in cybersecurity.
li
Minimum 2–3 years of proven sales team leadership or management experience.
li
Demonstrated track record of achieving both individual and team sales targets.
li
Strong experience selling cybersecurity solutions, managed security services, and SaaS subscriptions.
li
Solid understanding of SOC, MDR, MSSP, SIEM, EDR, XDR, and related cybersecurity technologies.
li
Good understanding of Saudi cybersecurity regulations, particularly NCA and SAMA requirements.
li
Proven experience selling to enterprise and mid-market customers in Saudi Arabia.
li
Established relationships with CISOs, CIOs, IT Directors, and other senior decision-makers.
li
Strong sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM skills, preferably HubSpot.
li
Excellent leadership, coaching, negotiation, and communication skills.
li
Fluent Arabic and strong English proficiency.
li
Bachelor's degree in Business, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
r: Lead, coach, and manage the assigned sales team to achieve individual and collective revenue targets.
Personally manage a portfolio of customer accounts and achieve an assigned individual ARR target.
Drive new business acquisition, account expansion, and revenue growth.
Manage sales pipeline, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
Lead customer engagements, commercial negotiations, and complex deal closures.
Conduct regular sales reviews, individual coaching sessions, and performance evaluations.
Work closely with Pre-Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success to accelerate opportunities and ensure customer satisfaction.
Maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers across the Saudi market.
x: 🚀 Impact that Matters – Build products that shape the future of cybersecurity and protect organizations globally.
